set protocols bgp group external-peers.explanation: This command configures a BGP group named [parameter1], defining a set of BGP peers with shared session parameters.

type external.explanation: Configure the type of BGP group to be external.

parameters.explanation: Local address of the BGP group.

neighbor 10.1.1.1.explanation: Configure the neighbors of the BGP team.

family inet unicast.explanation: Configure the IPv4 solo address of the BGP group.

export export-static-routes.explanation: Configure the strategy for BGP to guide the route.

parameters.name: export-policy
parameters.explanation: The policy name for the route.

set policy-options policy-statement expo.explanation: This command fragment defines a routing policy named `[parameter1]` in Junos, allowing you to configure specific routing rules, actions, and conditions for traffic control.

term 1.explanation: This command fragment configures a routing policy by defining a term within a policy statement, where `[parameter1]` is the policy name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: The term number of the policy statement.

from protocol direct.explanation: Configure the matching condition for the policy statement from the OSF protocol.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.explanation: Matches the protocol name, for example.

then accept.explanation: Configure the action of the policy statement as accepted.
